title: ProcArena: A Multi-Scenario Benchmark for LLMs on Direct and Interactive PL/SQL Development from Natural Language
abstract: arXiv:2609.06527v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong potential for translating natural-language (NL) requirements into PL/SQL programs, attracting increasing attention from the database community. However, existing NL-to-PL/SQL efforts primarily focus on directly generating PL/SQL from complete NL requirements. In practice, PL/SQL development involves diverse scenarios, such as from-scratch development, code modification, debugging, and optimization, and may require either direct generation or multi-turn interaction. Yet, no comprehensive benchmark evaluates multi-scenario, direct and interactive, and multi-dialect NL-to-PL/SQL development. In this paper, we present ProcArena, an execution-based benchmark covering both Direct and Interactive modes. translated_title: ProcArena：一个用于评估大语言模型在从自然语言进行直接式与交互式PL/SQL开发的多场景基准测试
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）在将自然语言（NL）需求转换为PL/SQL程序方面展现出强大潜力，引起了数据库领域越来越多的关注。然而，现有的自然语言到PL/SQL的研究主要集中在根据完整的自然语言需求直接生成PL/SQL代码。在实际应用中，PL/SQL开发涉及多种场景，例如从头开发、代码修改、调试和优化，并且可能需要直接生成或多轮交互。然而，目前尚无综合性基准来评估多场景、直接式与交互式、多方言的自然语言到PL/SQL开发。在本文中，我们提出了ProcArena，一个涵盖直接式和交互式两种模式的基于执行的基准测试。ProcArena包含跨157个数据库的3,998个可执行任务，涵盖PostgreSQL和Oracle中的九个开发子场景。我们通过迭代逻辑增强构建了具有挑战性的直接式任务……
tldr: ProcArena是一个基于执行的多场景基准测试，首次全面评估大语言模型在从自然语言进行直接式与交互式PL/SQL开发的能力，包含跨157个数据库、覆盖PostgreSQL和Oracle九个开发子场景的3,998个可执行任务。
en_tdlr: ProcArena is an execution-based multi-scenario benchmark that comprehensively evaluates LLMs on direct and interactive NL-to-PL/SQL development, comprising 3,998 executable tasks across 157 databases spanning nine development subscenarios in PostgreSQL and Oracle.
